description: Fork of exp659. Architectural change: replace separate qk_lut + v_lut with one joint qkv_lut, sparsified across LUT heads. n_heads = H*S = 6*4 = 24, n_out per LUT head = (2*d_qk + d_v)/S = 192/4 = 48. tph=64 per LUT head. The S=4 LUT heads of each real attention head h are stacked contiguously; reshape [B*T, 24, 48] -> [B*T, 6, 192] gives q,k,v concatenated per real head. Per-layer qkv_lut weights = 24*64*64*48 = 4,718,592 (vs exp659 qk+v = 786,432 + 3,145,728 = 3,932,160 per layer). Net per layer: +786,432; total: +4.72M. Expected total params ~91.22M. Tests whether joint qkv computation (shared anchor decisions per (real_head, sub)) helps. Reference: exp659 = 1.4820 (sep qk+v, 86.5M), exp650 = 1.4825 (w/resid 86.5M), vanilla SOTA exp328 = 1.3882.
